lang1.bullet1: Transforms main nutritional elements to plant accessible forms (microbiological fixation and release), as well as improves their absorption.
lang1.bullet2: Biostimulation – plants grow faster, become stronger, which results in optimal yield.
lang1.bullet3: Improves plant resistance to drought and other stress factors.

composition.label: Product composition:
composition.value: Paenibacillus azotofixans, Bacillus megaterium, Bacillus mucilaginous, Bacillus mycoides, Mycorrhizal fungus (Serendipita indica), vitamins. Total concentration – no less than 1.0 × 10⁹ CFU/g.

usage.label: Application rate:
usage.value: 0.25 – 1 kg/ha. For more specific information scan the QR code.

preparation.label: Preparation of the solution:
preparation.value: Mix the required amount of BioSpektrum WG with 200–400 l of water and spray / water the soil. We recommend that you dissolve the required amount of BioSpektrum WG in a separate container with water before filling into the sprayer.

storage.label: Storage conditions:
storage.value: The product, in tightly closed, original packaging, can be stored for 24 months at a temperature of +5 – +30 °C in a dry, well-ventilated place, protected from direct sunlight.

manufacturer.label: Manufacturer:
manufacturer.value: UAB "Nando", Europos av. 39, LT-46329 Kaunas, Lithuania
